label: Advisor reindex residual closed: advisor_rebuild is the explicit repair command - it indexes .skilled/skills/ and publishes a fresh skill-graph generation (reason: advisor_rebuild), skipping a live rebuild unless force:true; invocation `node .skilled/bin/skill-advisor.cjs advisor_rebuild --trusted --force true` (untrusted exits 64); the state database is the package-local .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/runtime/database/skill-graph.sqlite with the daemon as single writer.

Trigger-index drift guard isolated: the generator's own check mode `node .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/cli/retrieval/generate-trigger-index.mjs --check --json` (exit 0 fresh, 1 stale documents named, 2+ unreadable; writes nothing); CI wires it advisory-only in advisory-checks.yml and auto-repairs drift via trigger-index-rebuild.yml on main/skilled pushes (stages trigger-index.json plus corpus-manifest.json, generation-diagnostics.json, phrase-variants.json; Trigger-Index-Rebuild: ci loop guard); vitest coverage in runtime/cli/tests/trigger-index.vitest.ts and trigger-index-rebuild-workflow.vitest.ts.

Q5 counts (rg -c line-sums, hidden trees included, .git excluded): total 11,282 - history ~10,422 (specs 10,371: z_archive 2,508, research 1,954, iteration files 1,356; changelogs 51: packet 45 + .skilled/changelog 6) vs live ~899 (.skilled 846 + .hermes 53; packet itself 162); ~92% history -> EXCLUDE history from the rename sweep (no rewrite), accept moved-path warnings on re-validation of historical SOURCE tags, and regenerate the retrieval fixtures instead of excluding them. Occurrence-level cross-check: 15,104 (search tool, different unit/scope).

Ordered rename plan (13 steps, one verification each): baseline guards + saved live list -> git mv packet to sk-code-skilled -> hub registry/router/graph-metadata/SKILL.md + verify-router-sync --checks 1a,1b,2,3,4 -> bare-form alias classes + run-all-drift-guards.sh -> packet verifiers/tests/fixtures + sibling-skill refs -> doctor pins (SK_CODE_NATIVE_SURFACE) -> advisor_rebuild --trusted --force true + advisor_recommend probe -> compiled-route-sync.cjs + compiled-route-guard.cjs -> sync-runtime-mirrors.cjs + check-agent-mirror-sync.cjs -> generate-trigger-index.mjs + --check probe -> live docs sweep to zero -> exclusion audit (.opencode/cli-opencode untouched) -> validate.sh --strict + full guard re-run.

History buckets are excluded from the rename sweep by glob (specs/**, **/changelog/**, **/benchmark/**); generated artifacts are regenerated, never hand-edited (advisor_rebuild --trusted --force true, generate-trigger-index.mjs, compiled-route-sync.cjs, sync-runtime-mirrors.cjs); the trigger-index drift check is generate-trigger-index.mjs --check --json (writes nothing, exit 0/1/2+) and the advisor rebuild republishes skill-graph.sqlite through the daemon (single writer).

direction: Rewriting history references (changelogs, z_archive, research logs, iteration files) to sk-code-skilled
